blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Sen. Antonio Trillanes IV on Friday alleged that more than P319 million from the Chinese government and China-based corporations went to a banana chip company linked to Vice President Sara Duterte’s husband, lawyer Manases Carpio. Trillanes made the allegation during a press briefing in San Juan, where he raised what he described as red flags involving CALE88 Foods Corp., a company owned by Carpio. Among the issues he cited were the company’s reportedly low electricity costs despite operating as a banana chip manufacturer, zero trade receivables and payables, and the absence of rank-and-file employees.
